items.text: Washington (final report, TNF): OUT - C Lucas Patrick (concussion), TE Colson Yankoff (knee). No doubtful/questionable. WR Treylon Burks (foot) DNP Wednesday after working Tuesday but carries no game designation; Quinn says he should be available. No designation - TE Chig Okonkwo (hip), DT Shy Tuttle (shoulder), TE John Bates, C Matt Gulbin (all full); CB Amik Robertson (ankle) limited. IR/season - WR Terry McLaurin, WR Jaylin Lane, DT Daron Payne, DT Javon Kinlaw, LB Leo Chenal, RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt; LT Laremy Tunsil out until ~December. Jayden Daniels (left elbow) full all week, starts.
items.source: Sports Illustrated / Commanders On SI (final injury report, Nov 11)

items.text: NY Giants (final report, TNF): Questionable - LB Malik Harrison (groin, limited all week), the only Giant with a designation. Cleared/full - QB J.J. McCarthy (hip), RB Cam Skattebo (hamstring, returns after missing Wk9), OLB Abdul Carter (knee/back), WR Darnell Mooney, WR Malik Nabers, LT Andrew Thomas, RT Jermaine Eluemunor, TE Theo Johnson, CB Colton Hood. IR - QB Jaxson Dart, EDGE Brian Burns, LB Tremaine Edmunds, RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. J.J. McCarthy starts.
items.source: Giants.com (Week 10 tracker, final injury report Nov 11)
